scientific_integrity: Exact rank-type recursion and finite cap justified mathematically; two algorithmic implementations checked all capped instances. No computational check is presented as proof of an infinite stabilization.
scientific_limitations: Exact census is restricted to fixed red counts 2,3,4. All minimum lengths are relative to the fixed-count family; no global optimality for the 3- and 4-red witnesses is claimed. External independent review was not performed and equivalent historical enumerations may exist.
title: Exact rank-three type census for binary chains with two to four red markers
